canonical_project: YIDO Cheongna / Wonchang-dong Data Center Development Project
notes: YIDO's official data-center page lists its Cheongna Data Center Development Project in Cheongna International City, Incheon, at 50 MW. Data Center Map/USGBC place the related Wonchang-dong data center at 381-73 Wonchang-dong, Seo-gu; Cushman & Wakefield's 2H 2023 permits list includes Wonchang-dong Data Centre in Incheon by YIDO, 46,116 sqm.
